address_comment_regular: [Verified] Called by TESObjectCELL_Deactivate. Removes active and extended temp effects whose BSTempEffect parentCell field at +0x0C equals the unloading cell, irrespective of remaining duration, then releases the list's reference. Thus decal lifetime survives normal updates but not unloading its owning cell.
